仙界危机就这么解除，一群人也不知是该喜还是忧。

他们的前任仙帝哪儿去了？

仙界大总管哪儿去了？

时笙让人准备了一个简单的登基仪式，然后第二天众人就发现仙帝又易主了……

不对，是物归原主了。

仙帝很憋屈，他真的没见过这么奇葩的人。

“仙帝不好了，魔族彻底占领修真界了。”

仙帝：“……”

突然好想选择退位啊！

仙界派下去的仙兵仙将因为没人指挥，几乎是被魔族追着吊打，后来又召了半数回仙界支援，根本没取到什么用处。

所以那两个人只是为了给魔族争取时间吗？

仙帝觉得自己发现了什么真相，可是这个真相真的好操蛋有木有！

魔族派人送来了帖子，邀请仙帝一叙，仙界因为南海的事，还没恢复过来，和魔族打起来绝对是没有胜算的。

仙帝不得不赴约。

也不知道这两人谈了什么，反正最后仙帝将修真界的管理权给了魔族，然后魔族和仙界联手对付南海。

南海最终被灭，叶清秋和龙玦却在最后关头不知所踪。

君无期在之后来见过时笙一面。

“商姑娘，你这仙帝才当了一天，就当够了？”君无期好笑的看着时笙，当时他听到这个消息的时候，差点没笑崩。

这女人是有多无聊。

抢了仙帝的位置就当了一天，而且还是为一个男人抢的。

一想到仙帝说这件事的脸色，君无期就更想笑，他应该感谢她看不上自己魔君的位置。

“我连仙帝的位置都能抢到，这样以后谁还敢来找我麻烦？”时笙一本正经的回答。

君无期：“……”话糙理不糙啊！

“咳咳……我是来告诉你，叶清秋和龙玦在修真界，需要我帮你出手吗？”这也算卖她一个好，免得她无聊的时候来对付魔界那可就惨了。

这个商殊，看上去没什么危害。

The crisis in the fairy world was lifted just like that, and a group of people didn't know whether to be happy or worried.

Where did their predecessor, the Immortal Emperor, go?

Where has the great general manager of the fairy world gone?

Shi Sheng had people prepare a simple enthronement ceremony, and then the next day everyone discovered that the Immortal Emperor had changed hands again...

No, it has returned to its original owner.

The Immortal Emperor was very aggrieved. He really had never seen such a strange person.

"The Immortal Emperor is in trouble, the demons have completely taken over the world of cultivation."

Immortal Emperor: "..."

Suddenly I really want to abdicate!

The immortal soldiers and generals sent by the Immortal Realm were almost chased and beaten by the demons because they had no one to command them. Later, half of them were called back to the Immortal Realm for support, but they were of no use at all.

So are those two people just trying to buy time for the demons?

The Immortal Emperor felt that he had discovered some truth, but this truth was so damn good!

The Demon Clan sent someone to send a message, inviting the Immortal Emperor to explain that the Immortal World has not yet recovered due to the incident in the South China Sea, and there is absolutely no chance of winning in a fight with the Demon Clan.

The Immortal Emperor had to keep the appointment.

I don’t know what the two people talked about. Anyway, in the end, the Immortal Emperor gave the management of the cultivation world to the demons, and then the demons and the immortals joined forces to deal with Nanhai.

Nanhai was finally destroyed, but Ye Qingqiu and Long Jue disappeared at the last moment.

Jun Wuqi came to see Shi Sheng later.

"Miss Shang, you have only been the Immortal Emperor for one day, is this enough?" Jun Wuqi looked at Shi Sheng funny. When he heard the news, he almost burst out laughing.

How boring this woman is.

He held the position of Immortal Emperor for a day, and he only held it for a man.

When he thought of the expression on the Immortal Emperor's face when he said this, Jun Wuqi wanted to laugh even more. He should be grateful that she looked down on his position as the Demon Lord.

"I can even grab the position of Immortal Emperor, so who will dare to trouble me in the future?" Shi Sheng answered seriously.

Jun Wuqi: "..." What a rough statement!

"Ahem...I'm here to tell you, Ye Qingqiu and Long Jue are in the world of cultivation. Do you need me to help you?" This is a good way to betray her, lest she deal with the demon world when she is bored, which would be miserable.

This Shang Shu looks harmless.
